sql:
SELECT l.ordered_on AS day, l.store_no AS store_no, l.item_no AS item_no, 'total' AS series, l.sales_bottles AS value
FROM sales.invoice_line l
JOIN sales.store s ON s.store_no = l.store_no
WHERE l.vendor_no = '260'
  AND s.county_fips = '19163'
  AND l.ordered_on >= '2016-01-01'
assumptions: Diageo means vendor_no 260 (Diageo Americas), the vendor that sold the product, not necessarily the brand owner today
Scott County identified by county_fips 19163 via store location
Includes all Diageo products: every size, flavor, pack and barrel pick, since no specific brand or spirit type was named
History starts 2016-01-01 as required; forecast horizon is 6 months ahead since no horizon was specified
title: Diageo Products - Scott County Monthly Bottle Sales Forecast
product: All Diageo Americas products (every size, flavor, pack)
